verses.1: A song of praise for David.
verses.2: I desire to sing and praise God with all my heart.
verses.3: The wounded man and the broken vessel will be raised again.
verses.4: You will be honored among the nations, O LORD; and you will be praised in all lands.
verses.5: For your kindness is greater than the heavens above us, and your truthfulness knows no bounds.
verses.6: May God be exalted above the heavens and above all the earth, in honor of You.
verses.7: That your friends may be rescued, that Your Hand may save them, and that You may answer me.
verses.8: God, in His holiness, will make it clear what is right and what is wrong.
verses.9: I will give Gilad to Manasseh, and Ephraim will be given to Judah’s leaders.
verses.10: May the Lord curse him! May he be covered with dirt and rubble. May his clothes be covered with mud.
verses.11: Who will save me from this city of captivity? Who will let me live until Adonai comes?
verses.12: God has not abandoned us, nor will He leave us in our current state.
verses.13: May we receive help from Egypt, and may there be a way out for us.
verses.14: May God create a line between us, and He will separate our enemies from us.
